citation: Schalk G, McFarland DJ, Hinterberger T, Birbaumer N, Wolpaw JR. BCI2000: a general-purpose brain-computer interface (BCI) system. IEEE Trans Biomed Eng 2004;51(6):1034-1043. EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database, PhysioNet (Goldberger et al. 2000).
record_used: subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), channel POz (posterior), first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples) -- the SAME git-tracked vector the SVD-entropy, Petrosian, Renyi, Tsallis and dispersion-entropy cases use.
pipeline: readRDS(eeg_poz_s002r02) -> PhysioEEG::fuzzyEntropy(dimension, r=0.2): embed the signal, remove each vectors local baseline (mean), take Chebyshev distances, weight matches by the smooth membership exp(-(d^n)/r) with r=0.2*sd, and form FuzzyEn = -ln(phi_{m+1}/phi_m). The reference re-computes it with NeuroKit2 entropy_fuzzy across (dimension, r) and contrasts it with the crisp sample entropy (NeuroKit2 entropy_sample) at m=2, r=0.2, via reticulate. Deterministic.
note: The root is the POz channel numeric vector (shared with the SVD-entropy, Petrosian, Renyi, Tsallis and dispersion-entropy cases). Fuzzy entropy (Chen et al. 2007) is the FUZZY generalization of sample entropy: it replaces sample entropys crisp match indicator I(d<r) (a Heaviside step) with a smooth exponential membership exp(-(d^n)/r), so near-matches contribute partially -- markedly more robust and continuous on short/noisy segments. fuzzyEntropy is a NEW op completing the sample-entropy family (the ecosystem had sample and approximate entropy but not the fuzzy version). It reproduces NeuroKit2 entropy_fuzzy BIT-FOR-BIT (max |diff| ~4e-15) across (dimension, r). On real eyes-closed POz EEG, at m=2, r=0.2 FuzzyEn (0.948) is LOWER than the crisp sample entropy (1.327): the soft membership counts partial (near) matches the Heaviside step rejects, so more matches -> lower entropy. FuzzyEn is non-increasing in the embedding dimension (0.948 -> 0.704 -> 0.616). HONEST: the value depends on (dimension, r, fuzzy power n); here the NeuroKit2 defaults (m=2, r=0.2*sd, n=1); the reproducible content is the bit-exact family and the fuzzy-vs-sample contrast, not an absolute constant.
